Ashley Judd as Lexie Coop, a nurse with many children who becomes her best friend; Stockard Channing as Thelma 'Sister' Husband, a kind religious woman who takes her in; Keith David as Moses Whitecotton, a photographer who teaches her photography; Sally Field as Mama Lil, Novalee's mother; Joan Cusack as Ruth Meyers, a music agent who manages Willy Jack; Mr. Sprock is the Wal-Mart manager; Roger is Lexie's boyfriend; Mary Elizabeth is Forney's sister.
